Ravi (AE): Ping — Prospect MarinerHealth wants to run a POC for SSO/SCIM + RBAC. Their compliance team listed hard blockers: UK+EU data residency, HSM/BYOK (FIPS), SLO support, and evidence of immutable provisioning audit trails for 12 months. Also asked for Dedicated pricing if we need reserved capacity. Can SE/PS/Sec triage?
June (Solutions Eng): On it. Clarifying Qs: do they require SAML SLO? SP-initiated only? Any requirement for SHA-256 signatures / encrypted assertions? SCIM: JIT provisioning for contractors, delta syncs, and a signed webhook/receipt for provisioning events (for audit integrity)?
Lin (Pricing): I need estimated monthly tokens, peak concurrent requests, and whether they want EU dedicated region or multi-region failover to price correctly. Ballpark is fine. Also: HSM + extended log retention are add-ons.
Hector (Security): From their questionnaire: FIPS/HSM for keys (BYOK via HSM), SOC2 Type II, ISO27001, yearly pen-test, and 12-month tamper-evident audit retention. We support BYOK via customer-managed HSM (bring-your-own-key) — will attach guide. For tamper-evident logs we can provide append-only exports with signed manifests. Recommend Private deployment if they require on-prem storage.
Ravi (AE): They said primary IdPs: Okta + one RADIUS-backed ADFS for legacy apps. Require SP-initiated SAML, SLO preferred, signed assertions with SHA-256, encrypted assertions optional. SCIM: full lifecycle + JIT for contractors flagged as external, and group->role mapping from HR (payroll_id -> role). Domain enforcement across multiple verified domains: marinerhealth.com + uk.marinerhealth.co.uk + partners.mariner.net.
June (Solutions Eng): Tech notes to assemble:
- SAML: we support HTTP-POST/Redirect bindings, signed assertions (RSA-SHA256), optional encrypted assertions (AES-256). SLO via HTTP-Redirect/SOAP supported depending on IdP. Need IdP metadata XML. Example ACS/EntityID we can provide:
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://api.redwood.example/metadata/marinerhealth">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="true">
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://mariner.redwood.example/sso/acs"/>
    <SingleLogoutService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-Redirect" Location="https://mariner.redwood.example/sso/slo"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
- SCIM: v2.0 with PATCH and incremental delta. Support for JIT provisioning: we accept a `externalType` attribute to mark contractors. Sample PATCH to set contractor flag:
```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/789
Content-Type: application/json
[ { "op": "add", "path": "urn:mariner:externalType", "value": "contractor" } ]
```
- Provisioning audit integrity: we can emit signed manifests (SHA-256) for daily provisioning dumps and provide S3 location + manifest signature for tamper-evidence. Also support pushing events to their SIEM via secure forwarder.
- Rate limits: hosted default 60 reqs/min; Dedicated can be bumped.
June (Solutions Eng): For domain enforcement we support tenant policy: `verified_domains: ["marinerhealth.com","uk.marinerhealth.co.uk","partners.mariner.net"]` and `signup_policy: verified_only`. We also support delegated domain verification across multiple IdP tenants.
Lin (Pricing): Preliminary pricing flavors for planning: hosted POC = free credits for 2 weeks. Dedicated small (2x A10G equiv) ~ $13k/mo, mid (4x) ~ $26k/mo, large (8x) ~ $48k/mo. HSM/BYOK add-on +$3k/mo, extended tamper-evident audit retention (12mo) +$2k/mo. Private on-prem estimate +$50k one-time prep + infra cost, ETA 6-10 weeks. Discounts available for 12/24 month commits.
Hector (Security): I'll package SOC2/ISO docs, BYOK-HSM integration guide, pen-test summary, and a short writeup on tamper-evident audit manifests. Also confirm if they need field-level redaction for PII in provisioning logs; we can enable redaction at ingest.
provision-bot: Workspace provisioned: https://console.redwood.example/tenancy/poc-mariner (id: poc-mar-202410). Invites sent to poc-admin@marinerhealth.com :white_check_mark:
Ravi (AE): They asked for canned answers for questionnaire sections 5.1-5.9 by EOD Mon. Can we assemble short bullets + attachments (SOC2 PDF, HSM BYOK guide, manifest sample)?
June (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the technical appendix: SAML metadata template (incl. SLO), SCIM attribute mapping (payroll_id -> role), JIT provisioning flow, and manifest sample. Need their Okta metadata + an HR CSV with payroll_id & group membership.
Lin (Pricing): I'll prepare three committed scenarios (monthly commit for 3/6/12mo) and include HSM + 12mo audit add-ons. Will post in the shared drive.
Hector (Security): I'll upload the compliance pack and add a short mitigation plan: if they require in-country-only logs we should propose Dedicated EU/UK region or Private.
Ravi (AE): Timeline they propose: kickoff Thu next week, 2-week POC, decision in 28 days. Owners: June = SE, Lin = pricing, Hector = security.
June (Solutions Eng): Confirmed. Need their Okta metadata and HR CSV (sample of 100 users ok). Can someone request?
Ravi (AE): I'll email the admin and ask to upload to the drive. Tagging their security contact.
Lin (Pricing): Posting initial pricing sketches by EOD today.
Hector (Security): Uploaded compliance pack + manifest sample: https://drive.example.com/open?id=mariner-comply (redacted pen-test included).
Ravi (AE): Thanks all. We'll consolidate the canned answers and send to MarinerHealth legal by Mon EOD. :pray:
June (Solutions Eng): Quick snippet for group->role mapping to share: `{"group_source":"hr.payroll_id","mapped_role":"clinical:provider|ops:admin"}`
Ravi (AE): Moving to action items.
(threads end)
